verdict.rationale: Source openness is a fair question for a hosted browser-agent product, so the axis applies. The pack shows only a public GitHub repo for the SDK/CLI client (smooth-gh-1), with no license stated and nothing indicating the core product source is published under an open license. Community comments describe it as a third-party hosted service that is not self-hostable, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
